newsitem.title: USA: Sri Lanka seeks 100,000 T optional wheat - trade.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka seeks 100,000 T optional wheat - trade.

text.p: Sri Lanka will be seeking on November 26 a total of 100,000 tonnes optional origin wheat, U.S. exporters said.
The deal would include 50,000 tonnes of soft white wheat slated for December 9-18 delivery and another 50,000 tonnes of hard red and/or spring wheat for January 6-15 delivery.
Exporters said the wheat could be of U.S., Australian or Canadian origin. "If U.S., it would be under the GSM (General Sales Manager credit) program," a U.S. exporter said.
